title: Divergence: parser no-struct-literal context leaks into match arm bodies — a value-position struct literal in a clause-position match fails to parse (01-adts.md REQ-2/REQ-4)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
Failing test at thermite-syntax/tests/divergence_adt_parse.rs::divergence_clause_match_arm_body_struct_lit_parses demonstrates the divergence.

ROOT CAUSE: in parser.rs, parse_clause runs the clause expression under with_no_struct_literal (so a trailing 'Name { … }' is a block, not a struct lit — correct for the HEAD). When that clause expr is a bare 'match e { … }', parse_match parses the scrutinee under with_no_struct_literal then parses each arm body via parse_expr WITHOUT re-enabling struct literals. The clause's no_struct_literal flag is still active, so an arm body 'Point { x: 1 }' (VALUE position) is mis-parsed: 'expected }, found {'.

The other bracketed contexts (parse_call_args, parse_index_arg, the LParen primary) correctly re-enable via with_struct_literal; match arm bodies (and, by inspection, the if/else block tails reached through this path) do not. This is exactly the binary_search-shaped 'ens match result { … }' clause — the corpus passes only because its arm bodies happen not to construct structs.

AUTHORITY: .design/basis/01-adts.md REQ-2 (Expr::StructLit construction) + REQ-4 (match in expression position; arm bodies are value position). The fix (generator): wrap the match arm-body parse in with_struct_literal in parse_match.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Minimal single-file fix in thermite-syntax/src/parser.rs parse_match: wrap the arm-body expr parse in with_struct_literal (mirroring parse_call_args / parse_index_arg / the LParen primary). Arm bodies are VALUE position (.design/basis/01-adts.md REQ-2/REQ-4); the scrutinee parse keeps with_no_struct_literal and the { block delimiter is unchanged, and with_struct_literal restores the prior context on exit (no leak the other way). Verify divergence_clause_match_arm_body_struct_lit_parses goes green + no corpus/workspace regression.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: FIXED in 5ec3a70. parse_match arm-body parse changed from self.parse_expr() to self.with_struct_literal(Self::parse_expr) — the with_struct_literal wrap re-enables struct literals in the arm-body VALUE position, mirroring parse_call_args. Scrutinee parse (with_no_struct_literal) and the { block delimiter are unchanged; context restored on exit (no reverse leak). Pinned test divergence_clause_match_arm_body_struct_lit_parses PASSES. Gauntlet: cargo test -p thermite-syntax green (adt_parse 4/4); cargo test --workspace 437 passed, 0 failed; clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings PASS; fmt --all --check PASS. Corpus (sum.th, binary_search.th) unchanged.
